Still coming.|audio = Sk8P4rkProWave9.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 9 ([[The Takeover Event]], Pro)}} }} ==Description== The '''Reaver''' is an enemy that appears in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has decent health for its debut and above average speed, but it makes up for its high [[Defense]], making it quite dangerous. Due to a bug, '''Reavers''' with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute do not spawn the [[Slime]] upon death. ==Appearance== The '''Reaver''' is a humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig, with its legs being thinner than its arms. It has a very light green skin color, torn dark brown shorts, and a dark green fluid on its lower limbs. It is missing its right forearm, and has a pair of four ribs sticking out of the side of its torso. Most of the skin on its head is missing, revealing a skull. Its head also has patchy black hair on the sides, and it has green tumors across its body. ==Strategy== *As the '''Reaver''' has 125% [[Defense]], most sources of damage have their damage halved. **Towers with decent DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Hunter]] can be useful against it. **Support towers can be useful at boosting the DPS of your towers, allowing them to kill the '''Reaver''' faster. *Collision damage can be useful against this enemy, as it can bypass its defense, dealing full damage. This makes spawner towers like the [[Military Base]], [[Mercenary Base]] or [[Crook Boss]] useful against it. **Multiple of these towers also have multiple damage sources, some of which being splash damage, which also bypasses defense. *The [[Trapper]] can be useful against this enemy, as all its traps deal damage that bypasses defense. *Splash damage towers that can bypass defense, such as the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]], can be useful against this enemy. *Defense dropping towers such as the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]] can decrease its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Reaver.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Reaver.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseReaver.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ReaverWalkingAnimation.gif|Walk animation (3 May 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NEWGAMEMODETHUMBNAIL.png|'''Reaver''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} IntermediateThumbailParadoxumPI.png|'''Ghoul''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Game Master Ultimate Skin - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Reaver''' on a promotional video.
